name: poker-scope
description: Japanese poker study trainer with cash/MTT quizzes, spot analysis and equity calculator

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for(const f of ['index.html','style.css','icon.svg','app.js','engine.js','study.js','worker.js']) if(!fs.existsSync('dist/'+f)) throw new Error('GitHub upload is missing dist/'+f); console.log('Static assets ready');"
scripts.check: npm run build && node --check dist/engine.js && node --check dist/study.js && node --check dist/app.js && node --check dist/worker.js
